name: evo_run
description: Execute a verified local Micro-Tool script (.mjs, .py, .ps1, .sh) inside a bounded sandbox and return structured stdout/stderr. Saves 90%+ context window tokens compared to reading raw files.

args.description: JSON arguments passed to the Micro-Tool via EVO_ARGS and CLI.

tool_id.description: The ID of the evolved Micro-Tool to execute.

workspace.description: Optional absolute path to the active project workspace. Routes EvoKernel to the nearest .evo/ directory at or above this path instead of the MCP server process cwd.
